# Sportstalent

> Operating System for Elite Talent Development in Danish Clubs. A secure, GDPR-compliant platform for plans, athlete data, communication, and progress tracking — built by a 40-year veteran coach.

Sportstalent helps Danish sports clubs run their roster, build periodized training programs, monitor athlete readiness, and turn every event into a structured lesson. The platform is multilingual (Danish, English, Swedish, German, Norwegian, Arabic, Spanish) and works offline in the gym or on the field.


## Pages

- [Pricing](/pricing): Personal and Coach plans for athletes and clubs.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision and the veteran coaching team behind Sportstalent.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [Help Center](/help): Feature guides and changelog.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an athlete account.
- [Sign up as coach](/signup/coach): Create a coach account for your club.
- [Training program](/traeningsprogram): Sample sport-specific development plan.
